newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Banco Union to up capital.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Banco Union to up capital.

text.p: A medium-sized Venezuelan bank, Banco Union, will increase its paid-in capital by five billion bolivars ($10.4 million) to 15 billion bolivars by mid-year, bank president Ignacio Salvatierra said.
"The executive board has approved the increase, we're only waiting on the Banking Superintendent's okay," he told reporters.

Salvatierra said the bank was also looking to invest $30 million over the next two years to upgrade technology in order to better compete with foreign banks that now control around half the banking sector in Venezuela.
